name: The Penz Hotel
beschreibung: The Penz Hotel is centrally located in Innsbruck, just a few minutes' walk from the famous historic Old Town. The hotel seamlessly blends contemporary design with touches of regional craftsmanship, creating a distinct, upscale ambiance. Guests can expect generously proportioned rooms, a restaurant serving refined Tyrolean cuisine, and a wellness retreat with sauna and steam bath. Excellent public transport connections make exploring the surrounding mountain peaks effortless.
